alerts.title: Alerts
cmdk.placeholder: Jump to a page, symbol or action
alerts.page.lead: Checked every 15s. A condition must hold for two rounds to fire and clear for two rounds to resolve. Critical alerts also go to ntfy; a stopped monitor is pushed by daemon-watch on the host. Marking read only stops the reminder; an alert resolves when its condition clears.

today.gapsSub: Next 48h · the engine keeps firing through these
today.noPositionsSub: Click a price on the chart to open one, stop included

trades.noFillHint: Plans whose entry never triggered — a discipline log, excluded from win rate and R
trades.expandHint: Click a row for prices, notes and actions
trades.noRHint: No stop, so no R (there is P&L but no risk to measure it against)
trades.acctLevHint: Account leverage = notional / equity at entry. Not the contract multiple: this is how many times the account was put on. Kill distance is its reciprocal.
trades.killHint: The adverse move, in %, that takes equity to zero. 19% of BTC 1h bars exceed 0.85%; 34% of ETH's do.

setups.title: Setups
setups.howto: The close-based hit rate asks whether the read was right: a close through the target is a win, through the stop a loss, neither within 20 bars expired. The real hit rate asks whether trading this entry and stop would have paid: which level the wicks touched first, and whether the entry filled at all. Real well below close means the read was right but the stop was swept first (too tight, or a poor entry). Both are kept to avoid survivorship bias.
setups.regimeHowto: Hit rate = wins ÷ (wins + losses), resolved setups only. Disagreeing in a range scores low: trust the engine, don't chase structure. Disagreeing in a trend: structure may be right (the engine lags). Agreeing: highest confidence. Needs enough samples to mean anything.
setups.formingHint: The structure was not yet confirmed when recorded
setups.firedHint: This strategy fired when the setup was recorded — a valid sample
setups.gapHint: Close and real outcomes differ: the read was right, a real order would have ended differently
setups.none: No setups yet. On the chart, turn on the structure layer and use Record setup in the panel.
at.title: Auto-trade
at.sub: Paper first · switches live in env and config · this page is read-only
at.paperNote: Paper mode: there are no real orders or positions on the exchange. Each row below records the order the program wanted to place at that moment, and its outcome is inferred by replaying the candles that followed. Pending and open are simulated states, not real fills. Once live, this page shows the exchange's actual orders and positions instead.
at.unscored: %d fires that could not be scored are counted as open, conservatively (better to block an order than exceed a cap)
at.howto.live: Real money needs all three at once: master ON, paper mode off, AUTOTRADE_ENABLED=true. Right now:
at.howto.caps: Caps are enforced on the order path (autotrade.CheckCaps); the figures above come from autotrade.BuildBook, the same function the gate uses, so the two cannot disagree. The daily-loss halt re-arms at 00:00 UTC. Liquidation guard: the stop must sit within %.0f%% of the liquidation distance, otherwise
at.howto.capsRisk: leverage is reduced. Other guards in force: one fire per rule per bar, macro and earnings blackouts, one position per rule, and a cooldown after a stop.
at.howto.capsFixed: the order is blocked. Other guards in force: one fire per rule per bar, macro and earnings blackouts, one position per rule, and a cooldown after a stop.
at.howto.cooldownMixed: (Rules disagree on cooldown; the largest applies.)
at.byStopHint: Risk sizing: margin = risk ÷ stop distance ÷ leverage
at.positionsHint: Deduplicated positions, not lines in autotrade_paper.jsonl: a setup that re-fires every bar counts once
at.floatHint: Open positions marked to the live price
at.howto.pnl: Pending: the limit has not been touched and is still within its 6 bars. No fill: 6 bars passed without a touch, so it expired. Open: filled, not yet exited. Whichever level is touched first decides; if one bar touches both TP and stop it counts as a stop, conservatively. Net R counts settled positions only (TP or stop). Historical TP and stop are judged from closed-candle wicks, and the current state adds the live mark: a price already through TP or stop settles, otherwise an open position carries floating R at the live price (as on Today). Fill rate counts resolved positions only; pending ones are left out.
at.breakdownSub: all %d positions · each table's net R sums to the total above
at.notAB: This is a post-hoc split, not an A/B: groups are small and overlap (every position appears in all three tables), so they cannot justify switching a rule on or off by themselves. To change a gate, run shipgate at fire generation.
at.howto.breakdown: n is every position in the group, unsettled included; win rate and R/trade divide by settled TP plus stop only. Open, pending and no-fill have contributed no R yet, and counting them would make a losing rule look milder than it is.
at.howto.perf: The curve uses deduplicated positions, ordered by exit time (equity moves when a position closes). The calendar's days are UTC+8, while the halt's today R uses UTC days, so the two can show a different 'today'. That is deliberate: the halt must line up with the moment it re-arms.
at.howto.perfOpen: The curve holds settled positions only; %d more are open, floating %+.2fR, and not drawn.
at.howto.perfUnscored: %d settled positions could not be replayed (the candle window no longer reaches their entry) and are left out of the curve.
at.firesSub: One per setup · newest first · +N = hourly re-entries folded in
at.since: Only since %s (%d fires): every number on this page follows this range, not just the table
at.capBlocked: %d more fires were blocked by caps and count nowhere
at.capBlockedNote: They were blocked by the same-symbol-side, concurrency, margin or daily-loss caps, and the executor would not have opened them either. Note this replays today's caps over the whole history, not the settings that were live at the time. The log is never trimmed; this is a read-time filter, and 'All' shows the original numbers.
at.scoreHint: Structural fit /100 at fire time, comparable across strategies
at.absorbedHint: Folds in %d hourly re-entries of the same setup
at.noFires: No fires yet: the rules are running and enter only when a symbol reaches a range edge (bottom or top third). Mid-range, they wait.
at.autoRefresh: Auto-refreshes every 10s without losing your scroll position
chart.votesHint: System A consensus votes (+1 each, needs 3)
chart.recordHint: Record the current setup as a paper idea (whether or not you trade it), independent of the structure layer
chart.favOnlyHint: Show favourites only. The symbol you are viewing always shows, favourite or not.
chart.hvnHint: Volume-node targets (A3). The number after R is how many nodes stand in the way: +10R four nodes out is harder to reach than a clear +4.7R.
